meta.bit_reading_note: every circuit has six classical bits but the idle-neighbour Ramsey R0, which has one (the package's, manacitra.wait.build_wait_ramsey with neighbours="idle": M into c0). In the wait test (circuit W-no, W-ref; part W) c0 to c4 are the end lines' results (manacitra.wait.WAIT_TEST_ROUNDS) and c5 is M's; in the other circuits (parts R and B) M is measured into the label's m_clbit and the other bits read 0
meta.description: Kickoff 54, Day 2: the revised check again, on the code under review. The six chains of Kickoff 53 and Kickoff 52, fixed by the rule, not drawn: 31-30-29, 75-74-73, 120-121-116, 96-103-104, 143-144-145 and 144-143-142 (L1-M-L3). A known phase phi in {0, +90} degrees, one rz(phi) on M right after its first H. For the verdict, per chain and phi: W-no(phi), the wait test without refocusing; R1(phi), the active-neighbour Ramsey (manacitra.wait.build_wait_ramsey, its default); R0(phi), the idle-neighbour Ramsey (neighbours="idle"); per chain at phi = 0: W-ref (XY4) and Z; 48 circuits, each 2 copies of 3500 shots. Beside the verdict, each 2 copies of 1500 shots: per M, X then measure (X1), H with the four XY4 pulses back to back then H (XY4), and R1 at 180 and 270 degrees; on 144 (143-144-145) and 143 (144-143-142), a Ramsey over T_M with both neighbours idle, only L1 in |1>, only L3 in |1> and both in |1> (N-idle, N-L1, N-L3, N-both), at 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees. 104 circuits, 208 positions, in one random order; the sampler's own dynamical decoupling and twirling off, as IBM recorded them. The second submission: the first, on 14 October, was cancelled in the queue (first_submission).

fixed_before_the_data.rule: H54, the revised rule: DISAGREE if any informative cell's d1 interval lies entirely outside [-margin, +margin]; AGREE if every informative cell's lies entirely inside; NOT SETTLED otherwise; with no informative cell, the verdict carries ", uninformative". A cell is one chain at one phi; informative if its loss_R1 interval lies entirely above informative_floor. d1(phi) = F_no(phi) - F_ref (1 - loss_R1(phi)), loss = M's P(1) minus its P(1) in Z, F against the wait test's phi = 0 parity ideal

Beside the verdict, its own bootstrap, seed bootstrap_beside, n_boot draws, M's P(1) (the copies with replacement, each redrawn binomially) in the order its analysis gives, refitting on every resample

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import math
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE / "site"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import manacitra  # noqa: E402
from manacitra import wait as W  # noqa: E402
import hw_51 as K51  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 51's transformations, unchanged
import tabulate_history as TH  # noqa: E402  history 01's value comparison, unchanged

K50 = K51.K50
COMMIT = "e45f15d8e2de1796d552bad401e696ce9ba0be3a"
REUSED_SHA = {"hw_51.py": "e7e19a92b770d122bb8728c3f709c5e6f10214abb1243db455097215923b6146",
              "hw_50.py": "f6ed4e35ff8f03554586e81ddd06582f6d219f4a33b0c4dbe6773747b4e578ef",
              "analyse_53.py": "cad1d1e33c992ba1b6ef3ad11e2deb1e79aef51a22e9881648c10b0223d0bc94",
              "walk_history.py": "80f7606d7820fff335b2b0d8b66e73bcd3684cf2b17134d207884a6e12ab08cc",
              "tabulate_history.py": "4d5ff8ec85bf6381a16c5bdd0da933b986aba0df60f24243efe68e2cb8b0ce9d"}
CHAINS = [[31, 30, 29], [75, 74, 73], [120, 121, 116], [96, 103, 104], [143, 144, 145], [144, 143, 142]]
NEIGHBOUR_CHAINS = [[143, 144, 145], [144, 143, 142]]
VARIANTS = ("idle", "L1", "L3", "both")
PHIS_V, PHIS_4 = (0, 90), (0, 90, 180, 270)
COPIES, SHOTS_V, SHOTS_B = 2, 3_500, 1_500
SEEDS = {"order": 5454, "bootstrap": 54, "n_boot": 10_000}
M_CLBIT, L1_CLBIT, L3_CLBIT = 5, 0, 1
NOT_BEFORE = datetime(2026, 10, 14, 21, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
STAMPS = HERE / "stamps-54"
STAMP_FIELDS = ["utc", "kind", "stamp_utc", "stamp_raw", "new_stamp", "job_status", "q_T1", "q_T2", "q_readout_error",
                "g1_any", "cz_error", "cz_length", "other_values_changed", "any_value_changed", "snapshot"]


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


now = K50.now


def log(msg):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / "run.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")


def window_open(t=None):
    t = t or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    return t >= NOT_BEFORE and not (3 <= t.hour < 9)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the calibration record
def record_stamp(backend, kind, job_status="", refresh=True):
    """Read the backend's properties, save the snapshot if its stamp is new, compare it by value with the previous one
    (history 01's compare and other_changes), and append a row to stamps-54.csv."""
    STAMPS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = backend.properties(refresh=refresh)
    s = p.last_update_date.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    name = f"snapshot-{s.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.json"
    path = STAMPS / name
    rows_p = HERE / "stamps-54.csv"
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(rows_p.open())) if rows_p.exists() else []
    seen = [r["snapshot"] for r in rows]
    new = name not in seen
    row = {"utc": now(), "kind": kind, "stamp_utc": s.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "stamp_raw": str(p.last_update_date),
           "new_stamp": new, "job_status": job_status, "snapshot": name}
    if not path.exists():
        path.write_text(json.dumps(p.to_dict(), default=str, indent=1) + "\n")
    if new and seen:
        prev = STAMPS / seen[-1]
        c = TH.compare(TH.load(prev), TH.load(path))
        o = TH.other_changes(prev, path)
        row.update({"q_T1": c["q_T1"], "q_T2": c["q_T2"], "q_readout_error": c["q_readout_error"], "g1_any": c["g1_any"],
                    "cz_error": c["cz_error"], "cz_length": c["cz_length"], "other_values_changed": o["other_values_changed"],
                    "any_value_changed": o["any_value_changed"]})
    with rows_p.open("a", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=STAMP_FIELDS)
        if not rows:
            w.writeheader()
        w.writerow(row)
    return row


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the circuits beside the verdict
def logical_x1():
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name="X1")
    qc.x(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    return qc


def logical_xy4():
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name="XY4")
    qc.h(W.M)
    for op in W.xy4_sequence():
        qc.append(op, [W.M])
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    return qc


def logical_n(variant, T, phi_deg):
    """Kickoff 51's three-line R0 (variant idle) and R2 (variant both) construction (hw_51.logical), with X on only the
    named neighbours for L1 and L3, no RZ at phi = 0, and the neighbours measured into c0 and c1 at the end."""
    from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(3, W.WAIT_TEST_CLBITS, name=f"N-{variant}{phi_deg:+d}")
    xs = {"idle": (), "L1": (W.L1,), "L3": (W.L3,), "both": (W.L1, W.L3)}[variant]
    for q in xs:
        qc.x(q)
    if xs:
        qc.barrier()
    qc.h(W.M)
    if phi_deg:
        qc.rz(math.radians(phi_deg), W.M)
    qc.delay(T, W.M, unit="dt")
    qc.h(W.M)
    qc.measure(W.M, M_CLBIT)
    qc.measure(W.L1, L1_CLBIT)
    qc.measure(W.L3, L3_CLBIT)
    return qc


def same_as_k51(variant, T, phi):
    """logical_n against hw_51.logical: equal once the two neighbour measures (and, at phi = 0, K51's RZ(0)) are set aside."""
    def ops(qc):
        return [(i.operation.name, [qc.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits], [round(float(x), 9) for x in i.operation.params])
                for i in qc.data]
    mine = [o for o in ops(logical_n(variant, T, phi)) if not (o[0] == "measure" and o[1] != [W.M])]
    k51 = [o for o in ops(K51.logical({"idle": "R0", "both": "R2"}[variant], T, phi)) if not (phi == 0 and o[0] == "rz" and o[2] == [0.0])]
    return mine == k51


def made(qc, chain, backend, name):
    ins, isa = K51._made(qc, chain, backend)
    return K50.rebuild(isa, ins, name)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- build and check
def build_chain(chain, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    no0 = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend)
    tl0 = K50.timed(K50.schedule(no0, backend, chain)[0], t, dt, chain)
    T = K50.window(tl0, M)["T_dt"]
    c = {}
    for phi in PHIS_V:
        c[("W-no", phi)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, False, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
        c[("R0", phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, neighbours="idle", phase=math.radians(phi))
    for phi in PHIS_4:
        c[("R1", phi)] = W.build_wait_ramsey(chain, backend, phase=math.radians(phi))
    c[("W-ref", 0)] = W.build_wait_test(chain, True, backend)
    c[("Z", 0)] = made(K50.logical("Z", T), chain, backend, f"Z-{M}")
    c[("X1", 0)] = made(logical_x1(), chain, backend, f"X1-{M}")
    c[("XY4", 0)] = made(logical_xy4(), chain, backend, f"XY4-{M}")
    if chain in NEIGHBOUR_CHAINS:
        for v in VARIANTS:
            for phi in PHIS_4:
                c[(f"N-{v}", phi)] = made(logical_n(v, T, phi), chain, backend, f"N-{v}{phi:+d}-{M}")
    return c, {"T_M": K50.window(tl0, M), "tl_no": tl0, "T": T}


def part_of(k):
    return "W" if k[0].startswith("W") else ("R" if k[0] in ("R0", "R1", "Z") and k[1] in PHIS_V else "B")


def m_clbit_of(k):
    return 0 if k[0] == "R0" else M_CLBIT


def checks(chain, circ, info, backend):
    t, dt = backend.target, backend.dt
    L1, M, L3 = chain
    ideal = W.wait_test_ideal()
    T = info["T"]
    rec, tls = {}, {}
    for (k, phi), c in circ.items():
        lay = [M] if k == "R0" else chain
        ins, _ = K50.schedule(c, backend, lay)
        tl = K50.timed(ins, t, dt, lay)
        tls[(k, phi)] = tl
        ops = {a: int(b) for a, b in c.count_ops().items()}
        init = list(c.layout.initial_index_layout(filter_ancillas=True))
        p = W.exact_distribution(c)
        bit = lambda key, i: key[::-1][i] == "1"
        r = {"count_ops": ops, "no_swap": ops.get("swap", 0) == 0, "layout_as_named": init == lay,
             "non_delay_ops_only_on_chain": {c.find_bit(q).index for i in c.data if i.operation.name != "delay" for q in i.qubits} <= set(lay)}
        seq = K51.m_sequence(c, M)
        names = [n for n, _ in seq]
        if k.startswith("W"):
            r["exact_F"] = W.fidelity(p, ideal)
            r["exact_F_expected"] = math.cos(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2
            r["exact_F_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_F"] - r["exact_F_expected"]) < 1e-6
            r["structure_5cz_6meas_3reset"] = ops.get("cz") == 5 and ops.get("measure") == 6 and ops.get("reset") == 3
            r["both_couplers_used"] = {tuple(sorted(c.find_bit(q).index for q in i.qubits)) for i in c.data if i.operation.name == "cz"} == {tuple(sorted((L1, M))), tuple(sorted((M, L3)))}
            if k == "W-ref":
                r["pulses_on_M"] = K50.x_on(c, M) > K50.x_on(circ[("W-no", 0)], M)
        else:
            mb = m_clbit_of((k, phi))
            r["exact_P1_M"] = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if bit(key, mb))
            r["exact_P1_expected"] = {"X1": 1.0, "XY4": 0.0, "Z": 0.0}.get(k, math.sin(math.radians(phi) / 2) ** 2)
            r["exact_P1_as_expected"] = abs(r["exact_P1_M"] - r["exact_P1_expected"]) < 1e-9
            if k not in ("X1", "XY4"):
                w = K50.window(tl, M)
                r["M_window"] = w
                if k == "Z":
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == 0
                elif k == "R0":
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == W.even_wait(T, getattr(t, "granularity", 1) or 1)
                    r["window_beside_T_M"] = {"idle_even_T_M_dt": w["T_dt"], "T_M_dt": T}
                else:
                    r["window_ok"] = w["T_dt"] == T
            if k.startswith("N-"):
                prep = {"idle": (0, 0), "L1": (1, 0), "L3": (0, 1), "both": (1, 1)}[k[2:]]
                pl1 = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if bit(key, L1_CLBIT))
                pl3 = sum(v for key, v in p.items() if bit(key, L3_CLBIT))
                r["exact_neighbour_bits"] = [pl1, pl3]
                r["neighbours_read_as_prepared"] = abs(pl1 - prep[0]) < 1e-9 and abs(pl3 - prep[1]) < 1e-9
                w = K50.window(tl, M)
                meas = [s for _, nm, qs, _, s, d in tl if nm == "measure" and qs[0] in (L1, L3)]
                r["neighbour_measures_after_M_window"] = len(meas) == 2 and min(meas) >= w["end_dt"]
                if k[2:] in ("idle", "both"):
                    r["same_as_k51_construction"] = same_as_k51(k[2:], T, phi)
        if k in ("W-no", "R0", "R1") or k.startswith("N-"):
            i = names.index("sx")
            r["M_first_H_then_next"] = seq[i - 1:i + 3]
            if phi:
                r["phase_one_rz_after_first_H"] = seq[i - 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 1] == ("rz", 90.0) and seq[i + 2] == ("rz", float(phi)) and names.count("rz") == 5
            else:
                r["phase_none_at_0"] = names.count("rz") == 4
        if k == "W-no":
            j0, j1 = names.index("sx"), len(names) - 1 - names[::-1].index("sx")
            between = names[j0 + 1:j1]
            core = between[1:-1]
            if phi:
                core = core[1:] if core[:1] == ["rz"] else ["?"]
            r["M_ops_between_H"] = between
            r["check_cz_barrier_and_phase_only"] = set(core) <= {"cz", "barrier"} and core.count("cz") == 5
        rec[f"{k}|{phi}"] = r
    tab = {str(q): {"W-no unedited": K50.events(info["tl_no"], q), **{f"R1|{phi}": K50.events(tls[("R1", phi)], q) for phi in PHIS_4}} for q in (L1, L3)}
    same = all(v == tab[str(q)]["W-no unedited"] for q in (L1, L3) for v in tab[str(q)].values())
    rec["_neighbours"] = {"measure_reset_times": tab, "R1_same_as_W_no": same}
    flat = [v for kk, r in rec.items() if not kk.startswith("_") for v in r.values() if isinstance(v, bool)]
    return rec, all(flat) and same


def build(backend):
    circ, recs, infos, ok = {}, {}, {}, True
    for chain in CHAINS:
        name = str(chain[1])
        c, info = build_chain(chain, backend)
        r, good = checks(chain, c, info, backend)
        ok = ok and good
        circ[name], recs[name], infos[name] = c, r, {"T_M": info["T_M"], "chain": chain}
    return circ, recs, infos, ok


def items_list(circ):
    out = []
    for chain in CHAINS:
        n = str(chain[1])
        for k in circ[n]:
            for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1):
                out.append((n, chain, k, cp))
    return out


def assemble(circ, seed=SEEDS["order"]):
    items = items_list(circ)
    perm = np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels, shots = [], [], []
    for i in perm:
        n, chain, k, cp = items[i]
        part = part_of(k)
        lab = {"M": int(n), "chain": chain, "circuit": k[0], "phi_deg": k[1], "copy": cp, "m_clbit": m_clbit_of(k), "part": part,
               "built_by": "package" if k[0] in ("W-no", "W-ref", "R0", "R1") else "hw_54 (outside the package)"}
        if k[0].startswith("N-"):
            lab.update({"l1_clbit": L1_CLBIT, "l3_clbit": L3_CLBIT})
        circs.append(circ[n][k])
        labels.append(lab)
        shots.append(SHOTS_B if part == "B" else SHOTS_V)
    return circs, labels, shots
